uutiset.t: Video Shows Cruise Missile Targeting Crimea Bridge
uutiset.s: Video released by Ukraine shows a cruise missile moments before hitting a key bridge between mainland Russia and occupied Crimea. (Source: Volydymyr Zelenskyy via Storyful)

uutiset.t: JPMorgan Cuts Borrowing Costs on $2.85 Billion CCC Debt Deal
uutiset.s: Banks led by JPMorgan Chase & Co. have lowered borrowing costs on $2.85 billion in loans and bonds to help fund the acquisition of CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. by GTCR and Elliott Investment Management, on strong investor appetite for the leveraged buyout financing.

uutiset.t: Hammack Says Fed Should Set High Bar for Market Interventions
uutiset.s: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack says policymakers should establish principles for when and how to intervene in Treasury markets during an event at the Brookings Institution in Washington, D.C. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Disney Tops Profit Estimates on Streaming TV Growth
uutiset.s: Disney saw sales and earnings that exceeded analysts’ expectations in the fourth quarter, led by a particularly strong result in its streaming TV unit. Geetha Ranganathan of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: US 10-Year Yield Set for Historic Run Above 5% on Fed Rate Cycle
uutiset.s: The US’s 10-year Treasury yield is nearing its longest run above 5% in almost two decades as investors position for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates more amid stubbornly elevated inflation.

uutiset.t: Lucky Strike CEO Makes Take-Private Offer as Loan Hits Distress
uutiset.s: Lucky Strike Entertainment Corp. founder Thomas Shannon has proposed taking the company private after a bruising stretch in which its shares hit a record low and its debt fell into distressed territory.

uutiset.t: Gulf Oil Flow at Risk From Lack of Empty Tankers, Tracker Says
uutiset.s: The number of empty tankers sailing to collect cargoes of Middle East crude is sliding, a trend that could jeopardize the recent revival in the region’s oil flows to global markets, according to Tankertrackers.com, a firm that monitors vessel movements.

uutiset.t: Kazakhstan Has Given Over $1 Billion of Loans Lending to emerging metal tycoon
uutiset.s: Kazakh investment holding Baiterek lent more than $1 billion to two mining companies run by Nurlan Artykbayev, underlining the state support provided to businessmen who rose to prominence under President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev.

uutiset.t: SpaceX Debt for AI Chips to Hit Market as Soon as This Week
uutiset.s: A portion of $40 billion in debt financing to pay for artificial intelligence chips for SpaceX may start being sold as soon as this week, with Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and Apollo Global Management Inc. serving as underwriters on the expected deal, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.

uutiset.t: Goldman Traders See Stocks Grinding Higher Despite Nvidia Risk
uutiset.s: Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s trading desk sees room for US stocks to climb in the the coming weeks as resilient retail demand, corporate buybacks and a projected increase in buying from systematic investors help steady a slumping market.

uutiset.t: South Africa to Seek Relief From EU’s Proposed Hybrid-Car Curbs
uutiset.s: South Africa will seek an exemption or a country-specific quota if the European Union imposes safeguard measures on hybrid-vehicle imports.

uutiset.t: UBS Holder Cevian Sells Quarter of Stake Amid Capital Debate
uutiset.s: One of UBS Group AG’s major shareholders has sold over a quarter of its stake in the Swiss bank in recent months, coinciding with a period when the outlook for upcoming capital regulations worsened.

uutiset.t: Traders Cash In on Pricing Gaps in Anthropic’s Pre-IPO Contracts
uutiset.s: The frenzy surrounding Anthropic’s upcoming stock market debut has been playing out in digital-asset markets for months, with speculators betting on the artificial intelligence company’s value before its shares begin trading.

uutiset.t: ETF, CEF, Swap, Perp: Investors Get Slice of Anthropic Before IPO
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s much-anticipated Nasdaq debut isn’t expected until later this week, but retail traders are already finding ways to get a piece of the AI giant.

uutiset.t: Tech Stocks Waver Before Nvidia’s First Earnings Post-Huang
uutiset.s: Technology stocks struggled for direction on Tuesday as investors looked to an all-important earnings release from Nvidia Corp., while the selloff in the artificial intelligence trade eased.
